repos_data.description: CKAN is an open-source DMS (data management system) for powering data hubs and data portals. CKAN makes it easy to publish, share and use data. It powers catalog.data.gov, open.canada.ca/data, data.humdata.org among many other sites.
🌀 AI-native framework for building data portals. Scaffold a full portal from a brief and load datasets in minutes with agentic skills — any backend (CKAN, GitHub, Frictionless).

Data search & enrichment library for Machine Learning → Easily find and add relevant features to your ML & AI pipeline from hundreds of public and premium external data sources, including open & commercial LLMs
Cloud-native, data onboarding architecture for Google Cloud Datasets
The World's Most Comprehensive, Authoritative, and Structured Open Source Data Source Knowledge Base
Connect any Open Data to any LLM with Model Context Protocol.
InfraNode - free, key-less open-data REST API + MCP server for 84 German cities
Keyless MCP access to official Luxembourg public data — 21 tools over 15 public systems, zero dependencies
e-Stat API client and MCP server for Japanese government statistics (政府統計の総合窓口)

Open CC-BY-4.0 dataset of evidence-graded dietary-supplement data: dosing, bioavailability, drug-nutrient interactions, cost-per-effective-dose. Every claim carries a PubMed PMID. DOI 10.57967/hf/9356

US drinking water quality data by ZIP code — EPA violations, lead/copper levels, PFAS, radon, flood risk, and Home Safety Scores for 41,000+ ZIPs. 20 federal/state sources. Updated daily. CC BY 4.0.

Free, nonpartisan, bilingual tool to find your members of Congress, understand active bills in plain language, and call. Privacy-first: no accounts, no tracking.

Open dataset: cheapest new internal 3.5" SATA HDD price per TB (USD/TB) by capacity tier on Amazon US, with a daily time series. CSV + JSONL, CC-BY-4.0.
